game.title: Dead Island Riptide
game.blurb: First-person zombie survival action game from Techland, published by Deep Silver, released 2013-04-22. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Story: From the Storm to the Military Base

chapters.title: The Story: From the Roof to the Docks
chapters.summary: The later story achievements, from the rooftop fight to the docks, plus the other secret ones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Quests and Hub Defense
chapters.summary: Finishing every quest, barricades in hub defense and rescuing grabbed survivors.

chapters.title: Co-Op
chapters.summary: Main quests with partners and marking enemies for your co-op team.

chapters.title: Collectibles
chapters.summary: Secret files, guide book pages, the volunteer's voice recordings and other collectibles.

chapters.title: Levels and Special Enemies
chapters.summary: Reaching levels 50 and 70, the Twins, every special enemy type and the monstrosities in dead zones.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Mines, thrown weapons, kicks, head kills, charge attacks, chainsaws and the boat boost.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 4031); RAWG keeps "Dead Island: Riptide Definitive Edition" separately (id 10301). RAWG lists no Steam store link for this entry, and the only Riptide app in the Steam store list is 383180, "Dead Island: Riptide Definitive Edition", so that edition's achievements were used; its schema is named "ValveTestApp216250". 13 of 35 Steam achievements are hidden. ACH_1 to ACH_10 are hidden and named after places and story beats with falling unlock rates, so they were split five and five across two story chapters by API order (our own choice); ACH_30 to ACH_32 ("Serving Science", "First Do No Harm", "Defeat Harlow") are also hidden and were put in the later story chapter as a placeholder. StrategyWiki has no page under "Dead Island Riptide" or "Dead Island: Riptide". deadisland.fandom.com has no page under "Dead Island Riptide" but answers under "Dead Island: Riptide", with about 82 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
